subject: Post-discovery: partner-led technical deep dive & calendar coordination
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Briggs <eleanor@atlasgrid.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: partner-led technical deep dive & calendar coordination

Hi Eleanor / Matt —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can lock a partner-led technical deep dive: 

Summary (high-level)
- Use case: AtlasGrid wants a marketplace listing and dedicated connector for their managed clusters; goal is 1st production POC by Q3.
- Primary success metrics: <10ms median embedding latency for catalog lookups, <50ms 95th percentile on standard queries, and clear audit log retention for 12 months.
- Technical constraints: data must stay on customer VPC until pipeline validation; prefer GovCloud adjacency for US federal pilot.

Action items we committed to
1) Redwood: share architecture notes and proposed roles for the technical deep dive (see attached discovery notes).
2) AtlasGrid: share their internal infra diagram and pair of test accounts.
3) Coordinate a 90-minute partner-led technical deep dive (engineering + security + partner GSI technical PM).

Proposed slots (Pacific TZ) — pick one or propose alternatives:
- Tue, May 4 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed, May 5 — 13:00–14:30 PT

If those don't work, please suggest 2x 60–90 minute windows and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I’ve CC'd Vanessa (partner ops) and Jonas (solutions engineering) to lead the session from our side.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20270425.txt (notes from today's call)

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Partner Growth Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
